2.6.1.13.rationale: Ornithine aminotransferase (OAT) literature search returned no evidence of a second fused catalytic activity; hits were generic reviews of polyamine/proline metabolism mentioning 'multifunctional' pathways, not the enzyme itself.

3.1.3.62.rationale: Myo-inositol-hexakisphosphate 3-phosphohydrolase (3-phytase) literature shows no fused second catalytic domain; the one topical hit concerned inositol phosphate kinases, a distinct enzyme family, not this phosphatase.

3.2.1.10.rationale: Sucrose glucohydrolase / oligo-1,6-glucosidase search returned only unrelated microbiology/genomics papers; no description of a second catalytic activity fused to this glycosidase.

3.2.2.8.rationale: Uridine ribohydrolase (uridine nucleosidase) returned zero hits for bifunctional/multifunctional/trifunctional co-occurrence, consistent with a simple single-activity nucleoside hydrolase.

3.4.13.18.rationale: Xaa-His dipeptidase (carnosine dipeptidase 2 / CNDP2) hydrolyzes carnosine-like dipeptides; literature on CNDP2-mediated synthesis of N-lactoyl-phenylalanine (Lac-Phe) describes a reverse/condensation use of the same hydrolase active site (a moonlighting-like alternate reaction), not a second, distinct, separately-EC-classified catalytic activity fused into the protein.
3.4.13.18.evidence: PMID 41098976 (review describing CNDP2-mediated Lac-Phe synthesis as same-enzyme reverse activity, not a fused second EC activity)

3.5.1.4.rationale: Acetamide amidohydrolase (amidase) search returned only unrelated microbial genomics/agriculture papers; no evidence of a second fused catalytic activity for this hydrolase.

3.6.1.9.rationale: NAD+ phosphohydrolase (NAD+ diphosphatase/nucleotide pyrophosphatase) literature (e.g. classic liver microsome studies) treats it as a simple hydrolase with no reported fused second catalytic activity.

3.6.3.31.rationale: ATP phosphohydrolase (transport-associated ATPase) search returned only a single unrelated nitrile-metabolism paper; no literature describing a second fused catalytic activity.

3.7.1.8.rationale: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate benzoylhydrolase (BphD-type meta-cleavage product hydrolase in biphenyl/PCB degradation) showed no literature evidence of a second fused catalytic activity.

4.1.1.28.rationale: Aromatic-L-amino-acid (tryptophan) decarboxylase acts on multiple substrates (L-DOPA, 5-HTP, tryptophan) via a single decarboxylation mechanism; no literature describes a second, distinct fused catalytic activity.

4.2.1.66.rationale: Search for this EC returned almost no specific literature (one generic review on multidomain chimeric enzymes in general); no evidence found of a fused second catalytic activity for this lyase.

6.3.2.17.rationale: Folylpolyglutamate synthase (FPGS) activity is classically fused with dihydrofolate synthase (DHFS, EC 6.3.2.12) in a single polypeptide (FolC) in bacteria, plants, and apicomplexan parasites such as Plasmodium falciparum, explicitly described in the literature as a bifunctional DHFS-FPGS enzyme.
6.3.2.17.evidence: PMID 20350571 ("Characterisation of the bifunctional dihydrofolate synthase-folylpolyglutamate synthase from Plasmodium falciparum")

1.1.1.15.rationale: D-Glucitol/D-xylulose:NAD+ oxidoreductase search returned only unrelated E. coli genetic-linkage-map papers; no fused second catalytic activity reported.

1.1.5.4.rationale: FAD-dependent malate dehydrogenase (membrane-associated quinone-linked dehydrogenase) search returned only unrelated genome/metabolism papers; no evidence of a fused second catalytic activity.

1.1.99.5.rationale: sn-Glycerol-3-phosphate:(acceptor) oxidoreductase (membrane-bound glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, GlpD/GlpABC) search returned only unrelated genomics/lipid-metabolism papers; no fused second catalytic activity described.

1.13.11.52.rationale: Tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase (TDO) search surfaced general proline/tryptophan-metabolism reviews but no description of a second fused catalytic activity on this heme dioxygenase.

1.13.99.3.rationale: L-Tryptophan:oxygen 2'-oxidoreductase (side-chain-cleaving) returned zero hits for bifunctional/multifunctional/trifunctional co-occurrence, consistent with a single-activity oxidoreductase.

1.14.11.12.rationale: Gibberellin,2-oxoglutarate:oxygen oxidoreductase (2-ODD family GA oxidase) search returned only unrelated plant transcriptomics papers; although some GA oxidases catalyze multiple sequential oxidation steps, these use the same dioxygenase mechanism, not a second distinct EC-classified activity.

1.14.11.19.rationale: Leucoanthocyanidin dioxygenase (anthocyanidin synthase, LDOX/ANS) search returned only plant flavonoid-pathway papers describing it as one of several distinct enzymes in the pathway; no fused second catalytic activity reported.

1.14.11.22.rationale: Flavanone,2-oxoglutarate:oxygen oxidoreductase (flavanone 3-hydroxylase, F3H) search returned only unrelated flavonoid-transcriptomics papers; no evidence of a fused second catalytic activity.

1.14.13.151.rationale: (+)-Linalool,NADH:oxygen oxidoreductase (linalool 8-hydroxylase, a cytochrome P450 monooxygenase) returned zero hits for bifunctional/multifunctional/trifunctional co-occurrence.

1.14.13.21.rationale: Flavonoid,NADPH:oxygen oxidoreductase (flavonoid 3'-hydroxylase, F3'H, a cytochrome P450) search returned only unrelated plant transcriptomics papers; no fused second catalytic activity described.

1.14.13.89.rationale: Formononetin,NADPH:oxygen oxidoreductase (isoflavone 2'-hydroxylase, a cytochrome P450) search returned only one unrelated proteomics paper; no evidence of a fused second catalytic activity.

1.17.3.2.rationale: Xanthine oxidase (XO) interconverts with xanthine dehydrogenase (XDH) by post-translational modification/proteolysis of the same gene product, but both forms catalyze the same core purine-oxidation chemistry differing only in electron acceptor (O2 vs NAD+), not a second chemically distinct fused catalytic activity.

1.3.1.21.rationale: Cholesterol:NAD+ delta7-oxidoreductase search returned only general cholesterol-biosynthesis/metabolism reviews; no evidence of a second fused catalytic activity for this oxidoreductase.
